p: Anything that I am permitted to discuss
I am permitted to wait for nightfall for its sake, … should have … anything that I am not permitted to discuss … I am not permitted to wait for nightfall for its sake,

I am permitted to wait for nightfall for its sake, is not appropriate. Rather, the mishna should have formulated the principle in the negative: With regard to anything that I am not permitted to discuss on Shabbat, I am not permitted to wait for nightfall for its sake,
it is referring to the latter clause … But he may wait for nightfall … to guard
it is referring to the latter clause of the mishna, which taught: But he may wait for nightfall in order to guard
and he may bring produce in his hand.
Anything for which I am permitted to wait for nightfall I am permitted to discuss.
